tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper for the commercial pages and the portfolio; void for the product and every hero. Source: `.allok --paper` / `.allok --void`.

tokens.name: ground-2
tokens.usage: One step deeper than `ground`: board columns, section bands, the second surface. Source: `--paper-2` / `--void-2`.

tokens.name: ground-3
tokens.usage: Card ground on `ground` or `ground-2`. Source: `.rig --paper-2` / `--surface-2`.

tokens.name: ground-4
tokens.usage: Raised, popover and hover ground. Source: `.rig --paper-3` / `--surface-3`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body and controls on every `ground-*` (17.5:1 paper, 18.6:1 void). Source: `--ink` / `--on-void`.

tokens.name: ink-60
tokens.usage: Supporting copy. This is the colour of almost every paragraph on the site (5.2:1 on paper, 7.6:1 on void). Source: `--ink-60` / `--text-secondary`.

tokens.name: ink-40
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, timestamps; 24px+ or paired with a stronger neighbour (2.8:1 on paper, so never running text). Source: `--ink-40` / `--text-tertiary`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, list separators, input edges. Source: `--line` / `--hair-void`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px gap ink of `Hairgrid` and any structural divider. Source: `.rig --rule` / `--line-strong`.

tokens.name: rule-hard
tokens.usage: The 2px rule that opens a section or the footer. Source: `.rig --rule-hard`.

tokens.name: sky-night
tokens.usage: Sky stop 0%. The zenith at dawn. Never a UI colour on its own; it exists for the ramp. Source: `--sky-stops`, `src/lib/sky.ts DAWN.high`.

tokens.name: sky-cobalt
tokens.usage: Sky stop 26%, and the first stop of the mark's arc. Source: `DAWN.mid`.

tokens.name: sky-violet
tokens.usage: Sky stop 58%, the midpoint of the day. Source: `--sky-stops`.

tokens.name: sky-magenta
tokens.usage: Sky stop 82% and THE accent: numbering, bullets, inline links, focus ring on paper (6.1:1). Roughly 5% of any screen; more and it stops reading as accent. Source: `--dusk`, `DUSK.mid`.

tokens.name: sky-ember
tokens.usage: Sky stop 100%. The horizon haze at dusk. Source: `--sky-stops`, `DUSK.low`.

tokens.name: lit-dawn
tokens.usage: The dawn glow (left bloom of every sky plate), the sun of the mark, and the accent ON VOID where `sky-magenta` cannot carry (8.4:1 on void). Source: `--lit-dawn`, `DAWN.cloudLit`.

tokens.name: lit-dusk
tokens.usage: The dusk glow (right bloom), footer column titles and the seal's type on sky. Text on `sky-night`..`sky-magenta` only. Source: `--lit-dusk`, `DUSK.cloudLit`.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Every word set on a sky plate. Constant across the ramp on purpose: type that changes contrast as you scroll is a bug (min 5.4:1 on `sky-ember`). Source: `--on-sky`, `sky.ts INK`.

tokens.name: sky-dawn-low
tokens.usage: Horizon haze at dawn; the tint glass reads when `sky-t` = 0. Source: `sky.ts DAWN.low`.

tokens.name: sky-dusk-high
tokens.usage: Zenith at dusk, the far end of the sky machine. Source: `sky.ts DUSK.high`.

tokens.name: cloud-shade-dawn
tokens.usage: Shadowed cloud underside at dawn. Source: `sky.ts DAWN.cloudShade`.

tokens.name: cloud-shade-dusk
tokens.usage: Shadowed cloud underside at dusk. Source: `sky.ts DUSK.cloudShade`.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Portfolio only: focus outline and text selection in `.rig`. Not a status colour. Source: `--hazard`.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Product status: connected, paid, delivered. Always beside a word. Source: `--status-ok`.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Product status: informational, pending sync. Source: `--status-info`.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Product status: needs attention. Source: `--status-warn`.

tokens.name: status-risk
tokens.usage: Product status: at risk, expiring. Source: `--status-risk`.

tokens.name: status-lost
tokens.usage: Product status: lost, failed, destructive action. Source: `--status-lost`, `--destructive`.

tokens.name: viz-cyan
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (ops dashboards). Source: `--viz-cyan`.

tokens.name: viz-teal
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Source: `--viz-teal`.

tokens.name: viz-amber
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Source: `--viz-amber`.

tokens.name: viz-violet
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Source: `--viz-violet`.

tokens.name: viz-coral
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Source: `--viz-coral`.

tokens.name: wa-green
tokens.usage: WhatsApp's own green. Exactly one place on the site: the chat bar and send button inside the phone (`Conversation.tsx`) — there it is not decoration, it is where the product lives. Never a UI colour elsewhere.

tokens.name: wa-screen
tokens.usage: The chat wallpaper inside the phone. Source: `.allok-device-screen`.

tokens.name: wa-out
tokens.usage: An outgoing bubble in the phone (the agent's reply). Text `wa-ink` (13.4:1). Source: `Conversation.tsx`.

tokens.name: wa-in
tokens.usage: An incoming bubble in the phone. Text `wa-ink`. Source: `Conversation.tsx`.

tokens.name: wa-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside the phone; timestamps at 45%. Source: `Conversation.tsx`.

tokens.name: wa-ticks
tokens.usage: The ✓✓ read receipt in an outgoing bubble. Source: `Conversation.tsx`.

tokens.name: agent-out
tokens.usage: The agent's reply in a thread card on paper (`/vocero`); incoming is `ground-2`. Text `ink`. Source: `vocero/page.tsx`.

tokens.name: stage-won
tokens.usage: The won column of the stage board. Source: `rei/page.tsx Board`.

tokens.name: stage-won-ink
tokens.usage: The count badge of the won column (white text, 6.9:1). Source: `rei/page.tsx Board`.

tokens.name: assist
tokens.usage: The assistant's own colour in the product UI: the ✦ icon and the `Sugerencia` badge, the unread dot, an opportunity's value. `legacy-lime` in the site, kept here because the product still speaks with it (14.6:1 on void). Never text on paper (1.6:1).

tokens.name: assist-dim
tokens.usage: Ground of the `Sugerencia` badge. Source: `--lima-dim`.

styles.name: macro
styles.usage: The page IS the type. Uppercase, one weight. In code `clamp(3.4rem, 12.2vw, 11rem)`; this is the ceiling. Source: `.rig .macro`.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one headline of a commercial page, on void. `clamp(2.75rem, 7.4vw, 6.5rem)`, `text-wrap: balance`. Source: `.allok .hero`.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: allok cobra el software, no las conversaciones.
styles.usage: A sentence that owns a whole section. `clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 4rem)`. Source: `.allok .statement`.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: h3, plan names, card names, the wordmark in a lockup. Source: `.allok .display-sm`.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: El CRM de WhatsApp para negocios de servicios.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline. `clamp(1.0625rem, 1.35vw, 1.3125rem)`, `text-wrap: pretty`. Source: `.allok .lede`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Los mensajes los factura Meta a la empresa del cliente, al costo.
styles.usage: Everything else. Set in `ink-60` on paper unless it is the point of the block. Source: `body`.

styles.name: bubble
styles.sample: Sí — quedan 4 cupos en el de 9:00 y 2 en el de 11:30.
styles.usage: A message inside the phone. Source: `Conversation.tsx Bubble`.

styles.name: thread
styles.sample: Reservado a tu nombre hasta mañana 12:00, con el código 4471.
styles.usage: A message in a thread card on paper (`/vocero`). Source: `vocero/page.tsx`.

styles.name: inbox
styles.usage: A contact's name in the inbox; 600 when unread. Preview line is 12px `ink-60`. Source: `ConversationItem`.

styles.name: mono
styles.sample: OPEN FOR ONE BUILD AT A TIME
styles.usage: Uppercase. Labels, numbering, units, footer navigation, the band caption. Never a full sentence of body. Source: `.mono`.

styles.name: mono-time
styles.usage: Timestamps and counts in the inbox and on the board; `tabular-nums`. Not uppercase, no tracking. Source: `ConversationItem`, `Board`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, hairgrid gap ×4.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and mono labels; the seal dot.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked mono links (footer `gap-2` ≈ 8–12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; button vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter below `sm` (`px-5`).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from `sm`; gap between plan cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding at poster size; lockup gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter from `sm` (`px-10`); grid column gap in the footer.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on small screens (`py-16`).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding from `sm` (`py-24`); the sky plate's vertical room.

tokens.name: space-hero-tail
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a void hero whose object breaks its edge; the object pulls up with `-130px`. Move both together, tail 20px larger.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, table cells. Source: `--r-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small cards and popovers. Source: `--r-md`.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Every button. Source: `.allok-btn`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the mark's badge tile. Source: `--r-lg`, `icon.svg rx`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large content cards on paper. Source: `--r-xl`.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: A sky plate used as a card (the `/agencia` closer). Source: `rounded-[26px]`.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: The phone bezel only. Source: `.allok-device`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The lens, sliders, scrollbar thumb, the seal. The ONLY round objects on a page; the portfolio allows one per page. Source: `.lens`.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: A message bubble in the phone (14px in a thread card). Source: `Conversation.tsx`, `vocero/page.tsx`.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The white card that holds the thread or the board and breaks the hero's edge. Source: `/rei`, `/vocero`.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: The phone's screen, inside the 46px bezel. Source: `.allok-device-screen`.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting card on void; the slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popover, hovered card on void.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Modal, the device bezel.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The only shadow allowed on paper. Prefer `hairline` borders. Source: `--studio-shadow`.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The product card breaking a hero's edge (board, thread). The one big shadow on paper. Source: `/rei`, `/vocero`.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: The phone bezel on void. Source: `.allok-device`.

blur.note: Blur is what separates the sky from a template gradient. Two values, never others.

tokens.name: blur-glow
tokens.usage: The two radial glows of every sky plate. Source: `--sky-glow`.

tokens.name: blur-bloom
tokens.usage: The single bloom behind the product on a void hero. Source: `.allok-bloom::before`.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: The lens's backdrop. Source: `.lens > *`.

tokens.name: glow-dawn
tokens.usage: Opacity of the dawn glow on a static plate; `1 - sky-t × 0.4` when driven.

tokens.name: glow-dusk
tokens.usage: Opacity of the dusk glow on a static plate; `0.35 + sky-t × 0.6` when driven.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: `scale()` of a button on `:active`, the only tactile response. Cards use 0.98.
